t2.thesis: IREN has fallen about 9% on election-driven data-center fears, and its recent earnings reactions have been mostly negative, but a bounce is possible after the selloff. The entry open on 11/5 already prices in the political shock, so the exit-open outcome depends on the print itself.
reasons: Last 4 prints: only 1 of 4 positive at the open-to-open measure (25% win rate) despite EPS beats in 3 of the 4.
Stock is down 68% over 12 months, 47% in 1 month, and 71% below its 52-week high, with a heavy negative momentum and sentiment backdrop (I2).
Sector overhang from the Democratic sweep and the Texas moratorium risk (I7, I10, I11, I17, I20) is a continuing headwind for Childress/Texas-linked build-outs.
Counterweights: heavy oversold condition, 24% short interest, and strong fundamentals news (sold-out 2026 capacity, $4bn ARR, Microsoft Horizon 1 delivered) leave room for a squeeze or relief rally.
Implied move of ~16.7% and an ATM IV of about 2.6x realized volatility suggest a wide distribution with no clear directional tilt from the options.
t2.deciding_variable: Whether management shows Horizon 2-4 delivery timing and AI cloud revenue ramp on track, and addresses Texas policy risk and financing, enough to offset sector sentiment.

prior.from: I3 overall buy-everything hit rate (~54%; AMC 53.8%, ai_infra 55.8%); crypto_proxy cluster has n=8 so it is ignored

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-11-04, so that earnings report on 2026-11-05 hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how IREN's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Lowered from 0.54 to 0.45 (-9 points) for negative earnings-reaction history, sector political overhang and very weak momentum, partly offset by oversold/short-interest bounce potential.

theses.mechanism: Q1 revenue is weak as bitcoin mining runs down faster than AI cloud ramps, EPS estimates were cut sharply (-0.665 vs -0.26 30 days ago), and Texas policy risk persists.
theses.wrong_if: The company reports AI cloud revenue well above expectations and reaffirms the $4bn ARR timeline.

theses.mechanism: Oversold stock with 24% short interest rallies on contract wins, Horizon 2 delivery progress and financing clarity, with the political fears seen as overblown.
theses.wrong_if: Delivery slips toward the grace periods or guidance on capex and dilution disappoints.

theses.mechanism: The 11/5 open has already absorbed the sector selloff, and the print is mostly a known ramp story, so the move is driven by sector beta rather than company news.
theses.wrong_if: There is a large surprise in either contracts or delivery timing.

key_observations: AI Cloud Services revenue vs the Q4 FY26 level of $70.5m, and operating ARR progress from $1bn
Horizon 2-4 delivery timing and any use of the grace periods
Commentary on Texas data-center policy risk and the Childress site
New contracts for 2027 capacity and financing terms/dilution
Move in CoreWeave and Nebius on 11/5 relative to IREN
